quote.author: Jim Owczarski
quote.text:
The Bucks have now ruled Ryan Rollins out with an illness for tonight's game vs. the Heat.

Already the worst team in the league when totally healthy, losing a ball handler/shot creator/the best point of attack defender is not ... the best when trying to snap a 10-game losing streak.

items.title: Is Ryan Rollins the face of the Bucks?
items.author: Jim Owczarski
items.body_excerpt:
Is Ryan Rollins the face of the Bucks?

From team marketing to occupying a certain new locker - he is set up to be. He’s unmoved by the idea, however.

"It’s just more opportunity for me, more on my plate, more responsibility. I’ll take that for sure.“
